scope: Neutral canonical-state API, configuration, storage namespace, documentation and final qualification entry points
implementation: The sole full state is LedgerState; strict proof/definition admission is ArtifactLedger with ArtifactAdmissionError. Chain/consensus/storage/node/protocol/network/runtime types use State names; no research subsystem aliases remain.

StateNetwork exposes new_state, request_state and respond_state. Shared proposer arithmetic type names are neutral; existing arithmetic hash domains and all state-v1 golden wire vectors remain unchanged.

Canonical authority filenames are state.journal, state.lock, state-finality.anchor and state-signer-KEY.*. Create, reopen and observer reject legacy namespaces in both owner and anchor directories before locks or writes, case-insensitively for ASCII names; no automatic conversion.
Node configuration v2 uses agenda_profile. Version1 and the old research_profile field under either version are rejected without modifying input.

Current docs moved to docs/mvp, examples to examples/state-workflow, and tools to state_lab_acceptance.py/agenda_agent_codex.py. Historical evidence/PDF and mathematical examples retain exact bytes. Current links and CI process-test filter are updated.
Platform-specific helper cfgs correct the Windows -Dwarnings failure from be93d135 without changing Unix sync, Windows write-through/NTFS/destination flush, or unsupported-platform failure behavior.
No accepted deterministic MVP rule, mathematical checking order, reward, bound, time window, signature domain, or wire encoding changed.
